title: ToT Storefront compliance config (.tot/config.json#/compliance)
description: Regulated-commerce configuration. IMPORTANT: the mandated LEGAL WORDING for every notice is platform-owned and rendered by the platform's compliance widgets. You only flip flags and pass small parameters (minAge, chemical names, state lists). A widget renders NOTHING when its field is absent. Never fabricate facts; never remove/hide/paraphrase a required warning; enforcement/decisions/calculations stay platform-owned.

ruleProfile.description: The reviewed rule profile checkout enforcement evaluates (e.g. state no-ship and flavored-ENDS rules). A regulated store with no profile fails checkout closed.

minAge.description: Minimum purchase age (e.g. 21). Presence signals the tenant is age/identity regulated and shows the age gate. Go-live check `age_gate` requires 18+ for a regulated store; `excise` requires 21+ when nicotineWarning is set.

nicotineWarning.description: Show the FDA-mandated nicotine warning band at the top of every page (wording fixed by law). Also marks the store regulated and turns on excise-tax collection, which shows the fixed 'Applicable excise tax is calculated at checkout.' footer line on a store with a catalog (siteType commerce, the default).

pactAct.description: Show the PACT Act notice (ENDS/vapor) as a footer band on every page. Federal wording fixed by the platform. Satisfies the go-live `jurisdiction` check, as shippingRestriction does — a regulated store needs one of the two.

adultSignature.description: Adult-signature-on-delivery notice. Accepted and validated; not yet placed on any page.

shippingRestriction.description: Your own shipping-restriction text, shown as a footer band on every page. The ship/no-ship DECISION stays platform-owned. Satisfies the go-live `jurisdiction` check, as pactAct does — a regulated store needs one of the two.

prop65.description: California Prop 65 warning. The mandated skeleton, symbol, and URL are platform-owned; you supply only harm endpoint(s) and chemical name(s). Accepted and validated; not yet placed on any page.

purchaseLimit.description: DISPLAY only — enforcement stays platform/commerce-owned. Accepted and validated; not yet placed on any page.

stateEligibility.description: DISPLAY only — does not decide eligibility for a cart/address. Accepted and validated; not yet placed on any page, and it does not satisfy the go-live `jurisdiction` check (pactAct or shippingRestriction does).

exciseTax.description: DISPLAY cue only — the platform NEVER computes tax here; calculation is platform/commerce-owned. Accepted and validated; not yet placed on any page — the footer excise line comes from nicotineWarning and its wording is fixed.
